1 كَرِشَ , said of skin: see 5. ＝
-A2- كَرِشَ الرَّجُلُ, aor.
كَرَشَ , (K, TA,) inf. n. كَرَشٌ, (TA,) (tropical:) The man came to have a numerous family, or household, after a while. (Sgh.) And (tropical:) The man came to have an army, or a military force, after having been alone. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
